title: Refuse oversized door-knocking packs before the export runs
body: A pack over MAX_PACK_ROWS is refused before any chunk is read, but only after the CSV export has finished, and the export scans and stages every row before it reports its size. For a statewide district that is a long Databricks statement whose result is thrown away while the official waits. This counts the pack's rows first (same table, scope and rooftop gate as the export, through one shared FROM/WHERE builder) and refuses before starting the export. The export's own total is still checked as a backstop.
author: delegate-eval

@@ -416,8 +416,8 @@ which for a whole district is an unbounded materialization, so
 chunk at a time into the encoder.
 
 The encoder still keeps every person (~65 bytes of heap each), so a pack is
-refused with `VoterPackTooLargeError` when the export reports more than
-`MAX_PACK_ROWS` (3M) rows, before any chunk is read. A statewide district on
+refused with `VoterPackTooLargeError` when `buildPackCountSql` counts more than
+`MAX_PACK_ROWS` (3M) rows, before the export starts. A statewide district on
 `constituents` is ~21.5M rows, and building one exhausted the heap of the
 gp-api task serving it. The door-knocking stream logs that refusal at `warn`,
 outside the paging build-failure event.

@@ -14,7 +14,11 @@ import {
   PackRow,
   statusesToBytes,
 } from '../utils/packEncoder.utils'
-import { buildPackSql, PACK_CSV_COLUMNS } from './databricksVoterSql.util'
+import {
+  buildPackCountSql,
+  buildPackSql,
+  PACK_CSV_COLUMNS,
+} from './databricksVoterSql.util'
 import type { PeopleDataset } from '../services/peopleDataset.service'
 import { DatabricksVoterService } from './databricksVoter.service'
 import { readCsvChunkBody } from './csvChunkBody.util'
@@ -120,12 +124,20 @@ export class DatabricksVoterPackService {
     )
 
     try {
+      // Counted before the export starts. The export reports its size only
+      // once it has scanned and staged every row, so a statewide district
+      // refused on that total has already paid for the whole scan.
+      const { rows } = await this.client.query(buildPackCountSql({ district }))
+      const packRows = Number(rows[0]?.[0] ?? 0)
+      if (packRows > MAX_PACK_ROWS) {
+        throw new VoterPackTooLargeError(packRows)
+      }
       const { firstChunk, totalRows } = await this.client.startCsvExport(
         buildPackSql({ district }),
       )
-      // Checked before the first chunk is read: the size is known as soon as
-      // the statement settles, and every chunk drained past this point is heap
-      // the build can never give back.
+      // Still checked before the first chunk is read, for a district that
+      // grew between the count and the export: every chunk drained past this
+      // point is heap the build can never give back.
       if (totalRows > MAX_PACK_ROWS) {
         throw new VoterPackTooLargeError(totalRows)
       }

+  const bag = createBag()
+  const sql = `SELECT COUNT(*) AS count ${packFromWhere(bag, args.district)}`
+  return { sql, params: bag.params }

   const passthrough = [

@@ -1700,9 +1719,7 @@ export const buildPackSql = (args: { district: DbxDistrict }): DbxStatement => {
     ` AS ${ident('hasCellPhone')},` +
